fix_commit.message: avcodec/h2645_sei: Initialize side data before deallocation
fix_commit.author: Michael Niedermayer

findings.title: Use-after-free: AmbientViewingEnvironment side data written after side-data buffer may be freed on error path
findings.message: In h2645_sei_to_side_data(), when handling the Ambient Viewing Environment SEI, a new AVAmbientViewingEnvironment struct (dst_env) is allocated and wrapped in an AVBufferRef (buf), which is then handed off to ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext(). This function can fail (returning ret < 0) after having already taken ownership of / freed the buffer (e.g. if av_frame_side_data_add fails or another internal error occurs, the buffer ref is unreferenced/freed as part of cleanup). The code checks 'if (ret < 0) return ret;' correctly to bail out in that case, but only AFTER the buffer has potentially been consumed/freed. However, the fields dst_env->ambient_illuminance, dst_env->ambient_light_x, and dst_env->ambient_light_y are written AFTER the call to ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext succeeds check, but that write itself happens on the object that could have been freed as part of a partial failure inside ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext before it returns an error code being checked; more critically, on the success path the ownership of dst_env's underlying buffer has already been transferred to the side-data list, but the fields are still populated afterwards, i.e. dst_env may already be exposed to other consumers (e.g. other threads via frame side data, or freed if the ext function internally frees the buffer on certain failure paths) before initialization completes. This ordering was flagged by fuzzing (poc_hvcc_modified.mp4) as leading to a use-after-free: the buffer can be deallocated before its listed fields are initialized, because the struct data is only initialized after the call that can transfer/release ownership of the buffer, rather than before it.
findings.suggestion: Initialize dst_env->ambient_illuminance, ambient_light_x, and ambient_light_y BEFORE calling ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext(), so that the AVAmbientViewingEnvironment struct is fully populated before ownership of its backing buffer can be transferred or released by that call. This matches the actual upstream fix which moves the three assignment lines to occur immediately after allocation/before the side-data-adding call that may free/transfer the buffer on error or success paths.

ground_truth.root_cause: The struct fields for the newly-allocated side-data object are initialized AFTER handing the wrapping buffer off to a function (ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext) that can take ownership of / free that buffer, instead of before. This creates a window in which the memory the code is about to write to is no longer guaranteed to be valid/owned by this code path.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Use-after-free: AmbientViewingEnvironment side data written after side-data buffer may be freed on error path
